lead: A park asserted after the first `sched.run()` can be the connect's, not the read's.
body: `NvsTcp::connect_timeout` goes through `finish_connecting`, which parks wherever the platform says the handshake is still in flight, so `report.parked == 1` can hold with the read never having reached the reactor. Turn until the origin thread signals it holds the request, sending that signal before it writes any reply bytes; `a_socket_read_runs_on_the_reactor_and_parks_its_coroutine` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http/transport.rs` is the shape.
